capabilities: publish notes tagged with a configurable tag to a GitHub Pages Jekyll site
convert Obsidian wikilinks and image embeds to relative Markdown paths
detect and log links pointing to private untagged notes
split or merge notes at publish time using split and merge callouts
generate detailed Git commit messages and push via Git or WSL
disambiguation: Not a vault backup or Git sync tool; it publishes only tagged notes as a static Jekyll site.
extras: Described as a premium (paid) plugin and marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish only tagged notes to your own Jekyll site on GitHub Pages, including link conversion and Git pushes.

relations.evidence: publishing of notes directly to a GitHub Pages-hosted Jekyll static site
Initializes a stunning Jekyll template with
wraps and forwards commands to a WSL bash environment

summary: Selective publisher that pushes notes tagged #public to a GitHub Pages-hosted Jekyll site, converting wikilinks and automating Git commits.
